headline: Healthcare Software Implementation, Training and Configuration Specialist | Customer Enablement | MBBS-Trained Physician
summary: MBBS-trained physician with four years at Greenway Health, a US healthcare software company, where I consulted with, configured for and trained client practices so they got real value from the EHR. I owned implementations for close to 200 practices, from discovery through configuration and go-live, and trained 200+ end users, from providers to front-line staff. I explain clinical and technical ideas to different audiences, keep customers informed through each stage, and bring a clinician's view of how care is actually delivered.
greenway_bullets: Owned end-to-end EHR implementations for close to 200 client practices, from discovery and workflow documentation through configuration, setup and adoption.
Ran discovery with each practice to document pain points, business processes and goals, then configured practice-specific workflows and widgets to match.
Trained 200+ end users, including providers, nurse practitioners, nurses and medical assistants, with training matched to each role.
Acted as the client's main contact through implementation, setting expectations, tracking open items and clearing blockers with internal teams.
Wrote PRDs and feature requests from recurring client pain points and worked with product teams to get them built; many shipped to clients.
Triaged defects and patient safety issues from detection through stage-gate release as a member of the Patient Safety and Functional Advisory Committees.
Clinical lead for a new AI-first EHR from Aug 2025: defined provider personas, mapped end-to-end clinical workflows and built React prototypes before engineering handoff.
Presented to clients and at the Greenway Engage provider conference.
skills: discovery, requirements gathering, current- and future-state workflow mapping, system configuration, go-live support, customer onboarding
role-based end-user training, clinical staff training, SOP writing, user adoption, customer communication
defect triage, patient safety review, stage-gate release, clinical documentation workflows, emergency, ICU and inpatient care
thesis_html: Help customers get real value from the software: consult, configure, train.
why_fit: The core of their implementation team
